title: ProviderPack
description: Contract C2: the declaration of a provider pack (infra/providers/<name>/pack.yaml). A pack is the module infra/providers/<name>, the overlay clusters/_template/providers/<name>, the adapter products/catalyst/bootstrap/api/internal/providers/<name> and, where needed, plug-in charts under platform/.
$comment: spec.bootstrapUnits joins this schema in CLD-176, its reader.

charts.description: Folders under platform/ that this pack owns. Reader: leak scanner (CLD-211).

tofuProviders.description: Every OpenTofu provider the pack's modules declare, by fully qualified source. The version is read from the module's .terraform.lock.hcl. Readers: TestProviderPacks (CLD-090), provider mirror (CLD-172).

leakTokens.description: Lower-case words that identify this cloud. Reader: leak scanner (CLD-211).
